testimonials.name: Raja Sekhar Gowravarapu
testimonials.role: Technical Delivery Lead & Senior Integration Architect
testimonials.feedback:
Anil delivered strong performance throughout 2026, consistently demonstrating technical expertise, ownership, and commitment across multiple business-critical initiatives. He successfully supported and delivered enterprise integration solutions across key digital and payment channels, contributing significantly to both on-time project delivery and operational stability.

A key achievement this year was his contribution to the MuleSoft 4.9 modernization program. Anil played an important role in migrating APIs to MuleSoft 4.9 and CloudHub, ensuring thorough code remediation, testing, validation, and deployment while maintaining high platform standards and reliability. He also analyzed complex legacy integrations, mapped intricate dependency chains, and successfully migrated seven critical legacy endpoints to MuleSoft 4.9 while preserving business continuity.

Beyond individual delivery, Anil actively supported team success through knowledge sharing, KT sessions, critical incident root-cause analysis, and achieved the MuleSoft Certified Developer certification. With his strong problem-solving skills, continuous learning mindset, and proven delivery track record, Anil is a great candidate and a valuable asset to any engineering team.
keyHighlights: Migrated 7 Critical Legacy Endpoints to MuleSoft 4.9

testimonials.name: Bujjikonda Vedantam
testimonials.source: Capgemini Continuous Feedback · ESB Strategic Conversion
testimonials.feedback:
Anil Rana made significant contributions to the ESB Conversion Program, a strategic initiative that is critical to enterprise resiliency and cloud transformation objectives. He successfully delivered multiple API conversion efforts and played an important role in the successful execution of this high-visibility program.

Anil consistently demonstrated strong MuleSoft development expertise, taking complete ownership of his assigned deliverables and ensuring high-quality outcomes. Beyond his individual contributions, he proactively supported team members in resolving technical challenges, showcasing his collaborative mindset and commitment to overall team success.

His excellent communication skills, positive attitude, and ability to work effectively across teams have made him a dependable and valued team member. Anil is a strong team player who readily shares knowledge and contributes to a productive working environment. Overall, Anil's technical capabilities, ownership, continuous learning attitude, and dedication to delivery excellence have made him a valuable contributor to the success of the ESB Conversion Program and the broader enterprise integration portfolio.

testimonials.name: Raja Das
testimonials.feedback:
Anil is a dependable, high-impact member of the Conversion project whose technical skills and proactive attitude elevate the entire team. He can always be counted on to step up for additional responsibilities, consistently delivering accurate, on-time results—most notably through his work on key components of the enterprise Mule 4.x and 3.9 endpoint migration.

Anil is equally strong as a collaborator. He brings great energy to team meetings with thoughtful ideas that improve our workflows, and he is always willing to lend a hand to help colleagues get their tasks across the finish line.
keyHighlights: Consistent Track Record of Timely & Accurate Execution
